niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry, region and whether you need branding vs performance, creative production, measurement or omnichannel planning. I can recommend agencies, but first a quick way to find the best fit plus some commonly used names.

How to choose the best CTV agency for you
- Objective: brand awareness/upper funnel vs direct-response/performance — different agencies excel at each.  
- Budget & scale: global holding-company teams bring scale and premium inventory; independents often move faster and can be more cost-efficient for mid-market advertisers.  
- Creative capability: does the agency make/optimize CTV native creative and interactive units?  
- Platform relationships: look for partners with direct deals with Roku, Samsung, LG, Vizio, major DSPs (The Trade Desk, Magnite/Tremor, Xandr ecosystem) and programmatic CTV experience.  
- Measurement & verification: third‑party measurement (IAS, DoubleVerify), attention metrics, and clear viewability/fraud protections.  
- Data & targeting: first‑party data activation, identity resolution, and privacy compliance.  
- Transparency & reporting: media fees, third‑party measurement, and clear KPI reporting.  
- Case studies & references: ask for past results in your vertical and similar budgets.

Examples of firms to consider
(These are representative names used widely in CTV — some are global holding‑company media teams, some independents, some tech/platforms you’ll want an agency to work with.)
- Global holding company media groups (scale & premium inventory): GroupM (WPP), Omnicom Media Group (OMD/OMG), Publicis Media (Starcom), Dentsu, IPG (Initiative/UM)  
- Independent or specialist agencies with strong CTV focus: Horizon Media, MNTN (performance CTV), Cadent (addressable TV), Tremor Video (video specialist)  
- Platforms and tech partners you’ll commonly work through: The Trade Desk (DSP), Roku Advertising, Samsung Ads, LG Ads, Innovid (creative/ad serving), Magnite/Tremor (SSP/DSP ecosystem)

Practical next step
If you tell me:
- Your campaign objective (awareness vs conversions),  
- Monthly media budget,  
- Target markets (US, EMEA, APAC, local), and  
- Whether you need creative production and measurement/reporting requirements,

I’ll recommend 3–5 agencies or partners tailored to your needs and the questions to ask them in a pitch.
